reason: The ground truth is a runtime off-by-one bug: the continuation guard uses `<=` instead of `<`, causing the consumer to fetch one page past MAX_INTERVALS_PAGES. The reviewer's finding is entirely about test coverage and reporting honesty (no tests were added for the Intervals.icu path despite the implementer claiming otherwise) — it says nothing about the page-count comparison operator or the off-by-one fetch behavior. This is a different concern (test-coverage/process) at best tangentially related to the same commit, not a paraphrase of the same runtime misbehavior.
